stories.title: Indian banks' cash surplus shrinks as RBI tightens liquidity to curb rupee speculation
stories.summary: Indian banks' excess funds have fallen sharply as the Reserve Bank of India kept liquidity tight to deter speculation against the rupee, which has reached critical levels. The RBI capped its liquidity assistance at 1.5 trillion rupees, and overnight borrowing rates have risen close to the top of the policy corridor.
stories.why: RBI action or currency-market developments can affect rupee volatility, hedging costs and foreign-exchange conditions for businesses and investors.
stories.change: New high-signal event entered the brief.

stories.title: Ceasefire extended to cover Kherson region
stories.summary: A ceasefire that began on Tuesday to allow food and medicine into the Russian‑occupied city of Oleshky has been broadened to include the wider southern Kherson region, officials said. Several thousand Oleshky residents remain trapped without electricity, food or water, and all roads out are deemed unsafe. No violations of the truce have been reported since it started.
stories.why: This matters because it could expand treatment options or demonstrate a clinically meaningful new medical technology.

stories.title: General Compute raises $100 million Series A, valuation $800 million
stories.summary: General Compute secured a $100 million Series A round led by Blackbird Ventures and Abstract Ventures after landing a $100 million annual recurring revenue contract with a large customer. The financing follows a $400 million chip purchase agreement with SambaNova and the addition of Positron and Cerebras as inference‑chip suppliers, bringing the post‑money valuation to $800 million. The company builds its cloud using specialized inference chips and repurposed data‑center space instead of large GPU‑centric facilities.
stories.why: The capital enables General Compute to scale its inference‑chip‑focused cloud model while other AI neoclouds face market pressure.
